info.name: Selected fundamentals for a stock with values as of the end of a fiscal year.

items.docs: Selected fundamentals for a stock with values as of the end of a fiscal year; any other instrument yields empty values for stock-specific attributes. The endpoint allows the retrieval of data only for specified fiscal years by using the start and end properties.
